title: iDK ModPack
description: A balanced Minecraft modpack focused on exploration, progression, and performance, designed for smooth singleplayer and multiplayer gameplay.
body:
This modpack is designed to deliver a balanced and immersive Minecraft experience, combining exploration, technology, and adventure. It enhances vanilla gameplay with carefully selected mods that improve performance, add new mechanics, and expand progression without overwhelming the player.

Explore vast worlds with improved biomes and structures, automate your base using powerful tech mods, and face challenging enemies as you progress. The modpack is optimized for smooth gameplay and is suitable for both solo play and multiplayer servers.**__**
